title: Decouple lint runners, add incremental TypeScript transpile cache, prune legacy Docker stages
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Our monolithic CI images and combined lint/transpile runners are causing long pipeline tails, expensive total build minutes, and brittle cache invalidation. A single change to TS compile config or lint rules often forces repeated full-stage rebuilds. We also carry a set of legacy multi-stage Docker layers (old test/bootstrap stages) that add ~600MB to images and increase push/pull times across runners.

Goals: 1) Break out lint and typecheck runners into lightweight ephemeral containers that run in parallel and can be independently cached and scaled. 2) Introduce an incremental TypeScript transpile cache (persistent cache artifact keyed by tsconfig + package-lock + changed file hashes) to avoid full tsc passes on common PRs. 3) Remove deprecated Docker stages and rework base images into a two-tier profile (build-runtime minimal / dev-full) to reduce image size and layer churn. 4) Keep CI flakes <=1% and cut average pipeline wall time by 30% on standard feature branches.

Scope: repo-root JS/TS services, shared monorepo packages, and the primary CI builder images. Exclude cross-platform integration pipelines (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Lint and typecheck are decoupled: PRs show separate parallel jobs and failures mapped to clear job links
Average CI wall time on feature branches reduced by >=30% (measured across last 30 days of runs)
Persistent incremental TS cache reduces median tsc duration by >=70% for incremental commits
Docker builder image size reduced by >=20% and push/pull time improved in dev CI agents
No increase in CI flakes; any introduced flakiness tracked and rolled back before release
updates: 2025-02-11: Spike complete — ran prototype incremental tsc cache using mmap-backed file-store on a subset of packages; saw 60-80% speedup for typical PR diffs. Proof-of-concept scripts under internal repo 'ci-tooling/ts-incremental-poc'.

2025-02-14: Design review with DX and SRE — agreed to use a persistent S3-backed cache with content-addressed keys and eviction TTL of 30 days. SRE flagged IAM constraints for private repo builds; follow-up created ENG-831655.

2025-02-18: PR opened to split lint and typecheck runners: GH PR #4521 (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521). Initial run showed parallelization reduces critical path by ~22% but increased total concurrent job count; need autoscaling adjustments.

2025-02-20: Autoscaling proposal reviewed — added circuit to limit burst to 1.5x baseline for free tier accounts and 3x for dedicated agents. Metrics dashboard created: /dashboards/ci-agent-utilization (internal Grafana link).

2025-02-24: Dockerfile refactor branch removes legacy 'bootstrap' and 'legacy-deps' stages and consolidates runtime into slim image. Experiment on canary builder reduced image from 1.4GB -> 1.05GB. PR #4599 linked below.

2025-02-27: Integration test run for incremental tsc cache across monorepo succeeded on 9/10 runs; flaky run traced to a path-mapping edge-case in a legacy package. Added preflight step to normalize paths; follow-up test scheduled.
